channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: BSB Junrose Named Michelin Commercial Tire Distributor
item.description: Michelin is expanding its commercial tire distribution in the Philippines through BSB Junrose Corporation, which has been appointed as one of the tire maker’s new importer-distributors serving fleet and commercial transport operators. The appointment gives BSB Junrose a new product category for its

item.title: VinFast builds Pasay base
item.description: VinFast Philippines has opened a dealership in Pasay City as it continues to add retail and service locations ahead of its target of 60 dealerships nationwide by the end of 2026.

item.title: Toyota GR opens karting to more families
item.description: Toyota Gazoo Racing has launched the GR KART in Japan as an entry-level racing kart for children and families who want a more practical way into motorsports.

item.title: VinFast, GSM appoint new global chiefs
item.description: VinFast and GSM have announced changes in their senior leadership as both companies continue their international expansion.

item.title: GAC E8 HEV adds hybrid family MPV
item.description: GAC Philippines is pitching the E8 HEV as a practical middle ground for Filipino families who want electrified driving without having to plug in their vehicle.

item.title: Tesla starts paid Cybercab rides
item.description: Tesla has begun offering paid rides in its Cybercab, a two-seat autonomous vehicle built without a steering wheel or brake pedals.

item.title: Next stop, Singapore
item.description: Waymo is bringing its fully autonomous ride-hailing service to Singapore in 2028, and driverless taxis are now much closer to the Philippines than the streets of California where many of us first saw them.

item.title: This 113-Mile Overseas Highway Connects Florida To The Keys Using 42 Bridges
item.description: In the early 1930s, you could take a train to Key West, but you couldn't drive there. Today, the trains are gone, and you can drive to the end of the Keys.

item.title: Tesla reopens $50,000 Roadster reservations ahead of October 1 unveil
item.description: Tesla has reopened reservations for its next-generation Roadster, asking buyers for a $50,000 deposit about two weeks before the car is even unveiled. item.title: 5 '70s Sales Flops That Became Classics, And 5 Popular Cars That Didn't
item.description: Cars from the '70s were shaped by the 1973 oil crisis, making current views on popular and unpopular models nowhere close to what they were 50 years ago.
